name: session-report
description: Writes a readable HTML report of the session: turns, cost, files changed, commands, subagents and notes. /report opens it; one is saved when the session ends.

autoSave.title: Save at session end
autoSave.description: Write a report automatically when the session ends or is cleared.

folder.title: Reports folder
folder.description: Where reports are written. ~ means your home folder.
